text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I don't wanna go home yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho and I are in a bit of a
situation after
a day out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But why? It's not even dark yet!
choice_data_list: Still, we really need to head back...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanna keep going and I wanna eat
something
sweet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The witching hour is only just starting!
I'm not
going back! No way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she had a good time today, but
we need
to get back soon, or it'll
interfere with her plans
later.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Hey, come and get me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I notice some children that
seem to be
trying to squeeze in every
last bit of fun they can
before they each
have to head home.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! That's what you shoulda said from
the
start!
choice_data_list: Then let's have all the fun we can!
Let's cross using that magic circle.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Let's just get to the tr—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: I'll go talk to those girls.
I'll go talk to those girls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask the children if we can join their
game and
they gladly agree. However...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No! I don't wanna play any kiddie games!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
She's not gonna play?
Okay, let's keep
racing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Humph... Hrm... GRRRRR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be getting more and more
upset. I
wonder how I can get her to
enjoy herself...

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can you break off this branch? I
wanna make
a sword.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Making swords sounds like something
Sweep
Tosho would want to join in on!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...!
Did someone say magic?
choice_data_list: Looks like we're gonna need some magic...
Looks like we might need some magic...

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
No, I just need a grown-up to break it
off for me.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Huh? You can use magic?
choice_data_list: Ah... Oh! There's a witch, just in time!

text_block_list.name: Child C
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That's amazing! I wanna see! Show
us! Show
us!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Could you cast some of your magic on me, Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine! I guess I can if you really want me
to! ♪♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Powerful dimorphotheca! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you made two swords! How did
you split it
so perfectly?! It really was
like magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because it really is magic! I found a weak point and concentrated my magic there!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Here, I've enchanted this sword with
magical
power. Take good care of it!
choice_data_list: (It was less magic power and more sheer arm strength, but...)

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: Um... Yeah... I will, thanks...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That puts Sweep Tosho in a good mood
and she
plays with everyone after!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm tired. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What magic circle?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...You mean those hopscotch circles?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho points to a long stretch of
circles
that some children scribbled on
the ground.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Those were just drawn by some kids.
They don't
have any power.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: The witch of this land was the one who drew that magic circle.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? Tell me more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that the circles have
been
enchanted to give you more
strength the more
you cross them.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you suuure?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I guess there's only one way to find out.
What's
the order you have to jump?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Hop, hop, hop...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Wow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! I feel jam-packed with magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second... This is really magic!
Incredible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They aren't really enchanted, but it
looks like
there might have been a
placebo effect. She
seems to be in a
good mood.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? I feel like all my
strength is
draining...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! These magic circles aren't
complete!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So do something about it, Familiar!
They're losing
their magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hurry! Move your butt!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, so next is that white spot?! Got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come up with the idea to continue the
path of
magical circles along the white
parts of the
crosswalk... and successfully
bring her back to
campus.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, they stopped! Where's the next
magic
circle?!
